commands.name: anchor-rule-single-source
commands.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
anchor = "Never cite a symbol, file:line, test name, or count from memory or from a prior draft."
ref = 'the anchor rule in `writing-plans`'
t = {s: open(f'claude/skills/{s}/SKILL.md').read() for s in ('brainstorming', 'writing-specs', 'writing-plans')}
assert t['writing-plans'].count(anchor) == 1, 'anchor sentence not stated exactly once in writing-plans'
assert anchor not in t['brainstorming'] and anchor not in t['writing-specs'], 'anchor restated'
assert ref in t['brainstorming'] and ref in t['writing-specs'], 'anchor rule not referenced'
for s, body in t.items():
    assert body.startswith('---\nname: ' + s + '\n'), s + ' frontmatter'
    assert 'superpowers:' not in body, s + ' names a plugin-qualified skill'
PY
